pages.text: If you crouch while placing any kind of seeds in a diagram, you can place up to a full stack in a single item focus.$(br2)This lets the spirits know that the seeds represent a quantity, rather than the concept of seeds.
If such a quantity is influencing an action in a contract, it specifies that the mob must put or take exactly that number of items.$(br2)Two quantities instead define a range of permissible amounts.
